home.eyebrow: SERIVISI NZIZA YO GUSUKURA YA KIGALI
home.heroTitle: Dusubiza ibikoresho byawe by'amashanyarazi n'ibikoresho by'inzu bimeze nk'ibishya
home.heroSubtext: Dukoresheje tekinoroji y'ifuro yo gusukura mu rwego rwo hejuru, dusubiza ibikoresho byawe no kubyubakisha mu mimerere ihagaze neza. Teganya uyu munsi, tuza iwanyu.
home.badgeSafeTooltip: Bikoreye Ibyuma bya Erekitironiki: Tekinoroji yacu y'ifuro ryuma ntabwo ikoresha amazi, bityo ntiyangiza imihanda y'umuriro n'orongoranyamashusho.
home.toastBook: Umufasha wo guteganya yiteguye — hitamo serivisi utangire.
home.toastPlans: Gahunda z’inyungu zafunguwe — gereranya gahunda z’isuku zoroshye.
home.toastBookingFlow: Uburyo bwo guteganya bwarafunguwe — hitamo serivisi ukomeze.
home.headline: Serivisi nziza yo gusukura ya Kigali
home.subtext: Dusukura ibikoresho by'amashanyarazi, ibikoresho by'inzu, n'ibindi dukoresheje tekinoroji y'ifuro nziza. Teganya mu minota mike, tuza iwanyu muri Kigali.
home.whatWeCleanTitle: Gusukura mu ifuro ry'ubwiza ku masikuramu, ibikoresho by'inzu, n'ibindi byinshi
home.whatWeCleanText: Kuva kuri televiziyo na mudasobwa kugera ku sofa n'ibitanda, dusubiza ibintu bisanzwe uko byari bimeze hakoreshejwe ifuro ryizewe kandi rikwiriye.
home.ourProcessTitle: Uburyo bworoshye, bwiza, bw'ubwiza mu ntambwe enye
home.processStep1Text: Uzuza ibisabwa byacu kandi utubwire icyo ugomba gukemura.
home.processStep2Text: Turasesengura igikoresho cyawe tukaguha icyegeranyo gito vuba.
home.processStep3Text: Itsinda ryacu ryigishijwe rizaza hamwe n'ibikoresho bikwiriye n'ifuro.
home.processStep4Text: Unyurwa n'ibisubizo bisukuye, byizewe kandi bihangayikishije buri gihe.
home.trustText: ✓ Ifuro ryizewe  ✓ Abakozi bigenzura  ✓ Serivisi y'ubwishingizi  ✓ Kwishimira byemejwe
home.resultsText: Tekinoroji yacu y'ifuro irangiza ibyangiritse cyane, ifubika, kandi ikuraho udukoko udatera ibikoresho byawe by'amashanyarazi cyangwa ibikoresho by'inzu.

about.title: Turi 510 Cleaning
about.subtitle: Gusukura mu ifuro ry'ubwiza ku bikoresho by'amashanyarazi n'ibikoresho by'inzu i Kigali, Rwanda.
about.storyText1: 510 Cleaning Services yashinzwe n'umunyeshuri w'kaminuza i Kigali wabone ikibazo nyacyo — abantu bari n'ibikoresho by'amashanyarazi n'ibikoresho by'inzu biyadutse bigakenera isuku nziza, ariko nta serivisi yizewe n'inexpensive yabaho.
about.storyText2: Tangiye n'itekerezo ryo gutanga tekinoroji y'ifuro ya profesiyo ku rugo rwawe cyangwa ku biro. Nta biciro bigenga, nta nafaranga zihishe — serivisi y'ubugiraneza gusa ibazwa kuri WhatsApp mbere y'ugushika.
about.value1Text: Dukoresha tekinoroji y'ifuro ryuma isukura cyane nta koresha amazi — irinzwe burundu ku bikoresho by'amashanyarazi.
about.value2Text: Ibikoresho byacu byo gusukura birinzwe ku bikoresho by'amashanyarazi bihangayikishije, impuzu, n'ibikoresho by'inzu byibiti.
about.value3Text: Dukorera mu turere twose twa Kigali. Teganya kuri interineti hanyuma tuzaze aho uri.
about.value4Text: Turisubiza buri saba ry'icyegeranyo mu masaha 2, Kuwa mbere kugeza Kuwa gatandatu.
about.founderText: Iyi platform yubatswe kandi igenwa n'umunyeshuri w'kaminuza i Kigali. Tusobanuye ibikenewe by'abanyeshuri, inzobere, n'imiryango yo mu mujyi — kandi turikigirira kugeza serivisi nziza ku biguzi bigenwa binyuze mu biganiro bya buri mukiriya.

contact.title: Twandikire
contact.subtitle: Turisubiza buri butumwa mu masaha 2. Inzira ya ngiro yo kugeraho ni WhatsApp.
contact.whatsappText: Tutumagane butumwa buzima. Turisubiza vuba, buri munsi uretse Ku cyumweru.
contact.locationText: Tukorera mu turere twose twa Kigali harimo Kacyiru, Kimihurura, Nyarutarama, Gisozi, Remera, Kicukiro, n'ibindi.

privacy.title: Politiki y'ibanga
privacy.sec1Body: Twegeranya amakuru utanga igihe uteganya ubusabe: izina ryawe, inomero ya telefoni, aderesi imeyili, n'aderesi y'aho dukorera. Twegeranya kandi amakuru ku gikoresho cyawe n'uburyo ukoresha platform.
privacy.sec2Body: Dukoresha amakuru yawe gutunganya ubusabe bwawe, kukuvugana, kohereza imeyili z'inyemeza, no kunoza platform yacu. Ntiduhererezanya amakuru yawe bya bwite ku bandi.
privacy.sec3Body: Amakuru yawe abikwa mu buryo bwizewe kuri seriveri za Neon PostgreSQL. Kwemeza ubuzimagatozi bikoreshwa na Clerk. Itumanaho ryoherezwa na Resend.
privacy.sec4Body: Ushobora gusaba kureba, kuvugurura, cyangwa gusiba amakuru yawe bya bwite igihe cyose utumagane kuri WhatsApp. Turisubiza mu minsi 7.
privacy.sec5Body: Dukoresha ibikoresho by'ikoranabuhanga bikenewe gusa byo kwemeza ubuzimagatozi n'ibyo guhitamo kw'umutumiwa (insanganyamatsiko n'ururimi). Ntidukoresha ibikoresho by'ubucuruzi cyangwa gukurikirana.
privacy.sec6Body: Niba ufite ibibazo ku bwite bwawe cyangwa iyi politiki, tutumagane:

terms.title: Amabwiriza yo gukoresha
terms.sec1Body: Mu gukoresha platform ya 510 Cleaning Services, wemera aya mabwiriza. Niba udashaka, nyamuneka ntukoreshe serivisi.
terms.sec2Body: 510 Cleaning Services itanga isuku y'ifuro ya profesiyo ku bikoresho by'amashanyarazi n'ibikoresho by'inzu i Kigali. Ibiciro byose bigenwa kandi bibazwa kuri WhatsApp mbere y'uko serivisi iranguriwe.
terms.sec3Body: Ubusabe bwo guteganya ntabwo ari ikiganiro cyemejwe kugeza itsinda ryacu rikuvugana ryemeze itariki, igihe, n'igiciro kivugwaho.
terms.sec4Body: Ushobora guhagarika ubusabe butegereje igihe cyose ukoresheje ikibaho cyawe. Dusaba ko guhagarika bikorwa nibura masaha 2 mbere y'igihe cy'isuku igenwe.
terms.sec5Body: 510 Cleaning Services ikoresha tekinoroji y'ifuro ryuma ya profesiyo iririnzwe ku bikoresho by'amashanyarazi n'ibikoresho by'inzu. Ariko ntiturisubiza ibyangiritse byari bisanzwe. Itsinda ryacu rizasuzuma ibikoresho mbere yo gusukura.
